task.description:
WF-03 Step 1: Root cause diagnosis for GH-533 / ISS-0209.

Read ISS-0209.json, the failing test file tests/integration/auth/test_api08_auth.zig, and any other relevant files (test harness / cleanup / schema isolation utilities).

Determine:
- Why tenant_default DROP SCHEMA recovery races concurrent zig build test binaries
- What 21 specific tests fail with C42P01 (table does not exist)
- What the actual race window is (concurrent test binaries both provisioning+dropping the same schema?)
- Whether the fix needs synchronization, serialization, or isolation

Write a diagnosis report to docs/issue-reports/ISS-0209-diagnosis.yaml with:
- summary
- affected_files (list each file with line range)
- root_cause (concrete technical description)
- repro_steps (numbered)
- candidate_fix (high-level)
- acceptance_criteria (testable)
- prevention

Complete handoff with PASS once report exists and is complete. Do NOT write source code.
acceptance_criteria: Diagnosis identifies the race window concretely
Candidate fix proposal is high-level but concrete

result.summary: Diagnosed ISS-0209 as an unguarded tenant_default DROP SCHEMA CASCADE recovery race and documented the concrete race window, 21 affected tests, and synchronization/isolation recommendations. No source code was modified.
